chapters.1.meaning: The count prepares the tribes for travel and war. The Levites receive duties at the meeting tent.
chapters.5.summary: The laws cover camp rules and repayment for wrongs. They include a ceremony for accusations against a wife.
chapters.6.summary: People can make a special vow to God. It limits wine, hair cutting, and contact with the dead. God also gives priests words of blessing.
chapters.11.meaning: Moses needs help leading the people. He welcomes others who receive God’s Spirit.
chapters.17.meaning: Aaron’s staff grows buds, flowers, and almonds. God uses this sign to confirm Aaron’s priestly service.
chapters.19.summary: Eleazar oversees the burning of a red cow. Its ashes enter water used after contact with the dead.
chapters.21.meaning: The people complain and suffer snake bites. Those who look at the bronze snake live.
chapters.25.lds: Why does the manual connect this chapter with priestly responsibility? The ancient killings are not duties for readers today.
chapters.28.summary: God gives offerings for daily worship and special days. These include Sabbaths, new moons, Passover, and the first harvest.
chapters.29.summary: God gives offerings for three yearly holy days. These include the trumpet day, the Day of Atonement, and the feast of booths.
chapters.33.meaning: The camp list recalls stages of Israel’s journey. Many places cannot be located today.
people.moses.meaning: Moses teaches God’s laws and asks God to help the people. He chooses Joshua to lead after him.
people.eleazar.meaning: Eleazar becomes priest after Aaron’s death. He helps count the people and assign their land.
people.hobab.meaning: Moses asks Hobab to guide the camp. Hobab knows the desert places.
people.medad.meaning: Medad receives God’s Spirit while still in the camp. He speaks without attending the elders’ gathering.
people.dathan.meaning: Dathan refuses Moses’s call to meet. He accuses Moses of failing to give the people land.
people.phinehas.meaning: Phinehas kills Zimri and Cozbi during the crisis at Peor. God then promises his family priestly service.
people.zimri.relations: Son of Salu. He brings Cozbi into the camp.
people.cozbi.meaning: Cozbi is killed with Zimri. The chapter names her father but gives none of her own words.
people.sihon.meaning: Sihon refuses Israel passage through his land. His defeat opens land for Israel’s eastern tribes.
people.og.meaning: Og brings his army against Israel. Israel defeats him and takes towns in Bashan.
places.kadesh.summary: Israel camps at Kadesh near Canaan. Moses sends scouts from this area.
